category_title: Young students with EBD, ADHD, and ODD exhibiting noncompliance and disrobing behaviors
scenario_title: Non-preferred academic task in individual work area
minimal_context: Axel is sitting in his individual work area being asked to complete a reading assignment by his teacher.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Axel, it is time to work on your reading assignment in your work area.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't want to read! It's too hard! (pushes the book away, looking angry)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to open the book and start reading the first page.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No! I'm not doing it! (kicks off his shoes)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please put your shoes back on and look at your book.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Screams a swear word, pulls off his socks, makes an obscene gesture, and throws the book out of the work area)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Axel, it is time to work on your reading assignment in your work area.

STUDENT: I don't want to read! It's too hard! (pushes the book away, looking angry)

TUTOR: You need to open the book and start reading the first page.

STUDENT: No! I'm not doing it! (kicks off his shoes)

TUTOR: Please put your shoes back on and look at your book.

STUDENT: (Screams a swear word, pulls off his socks, makes an obscene gesture, and throws the book out of the work area)

task.content: Work on non-preferred tasks and academic activities he perceived to be difficult

context.environment: Individual work area in a self-contained, special education classroom
context.materials: Plastic clipboard containing consequence maps (created with Picture Communication Symbols, positive track outlined in yellow, negative track in brown) and a calm down schedule with rectangular blank boxes next to four target responses
context.social_setting: One-on-one instructional work area with a staff member or teacher

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When asked to work on non-preferred tasks and academic activities he perceived to be difficult
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Removed his clothes (shoes and socks), screamed swear words, made obscene gestures towards staff and students, threw classroom materials out of his individual work area, and hit an adult
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Feeling angry and having difficulty expressing frustration and other emotions appropriately

behavior_patterns.condition: When he did not want to comply with a task demand or teacher request
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Removed his clothes, screamed swear words, made obscene gestures towards staff and students, and threw classroom materials
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Difficulty expressing frustration and other emotions appropriately

behavior_patterns.condition: When reviewing the calm down schedule during morning review
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Touches each box with his finger, talks about the positive and negative tracks, and repeats the target responses
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Appeared to enjoy reading the consequence maps and enthusiastic about choosing a behavioral path
related_quotes: I have calmed down when I am using a quiet voice, breathing soft, when there is no hitting and no throwing.
